sources.title: GLM-5.2-NVFP4 · Models
sources.snippet: This model was obtained by quantizing the weights and activations of GLM-5.2 to NVFP4 data type, ready for inference with SGLang and vLLM. Only the weights and activations of the linear operators within transformer blocks in MoE experts are quantized.

sources.title: GLM-5.2-NVFP4: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview GLM-5.2-NVFP4 is a quantized Mixture-of-Experts language model built by nvidia for efficient inference on NVIDIA GPU systems. The model contains 753 billion parameters in total with 40 billion activated at runtime, using a sparse attention architecture with an IndexShare indexer to support context lengths up to 1 million tokens.
